propositions: match_predicate's value parameter is un-annotated and type depends on operator: scalar for eq/lt/le/gt/ge, iterable for in, tuple pair for range.
Annotating value as object produces 7 real mypy errors in the function body; Any annotation would satisfy the ratchet without providing navigability or contract enforcement.
A PredicateValue union type (str | AbstractSet[str] | tuple[str|None, str|None]) should model the operator-tagged predicate so type narrowing occurs by construction.
reducer._query._parse_value must return tuple[str, PredicateValue] and reducer._filters.apply_ticket_filters must conform to the new union annotation.
rebar.reducer.* must be promoted into tier-1 mypy override and _RATCHET_BASELINE after match_predicate is properly typed.
